body:
Pass 10. Stayed off Epic 4 - compiler.R was mid-write. Noted you picked up 0A; the eight edge-op exports are all still present, no action needed yet.

New p1, bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED, which I have been sitting on since pass 2 and think now needs raising. HEAD b5d9a33 "Certify the effectagram 0.1 foundation" does not contain measurement.R or tomography.R - verified with git cat-file - nor 14 other R files. 16 R files and 26 test files are untracked, including everything built this session: metric.R, relation-fit.R, support-index.R, geometry-plan.R.

So the certification-report SHA b6684bc0... covers a tree that was never committed and cannot be recovered. Epic 9 will certify again on the same tree unless that changes.

The part I would act on today regardless: a stray git clean -fd or a checkout would destroy the entire output of Epics 1-3 with no recovery point - including the metric module I verified this session. And Epic 0A is about to delete exports from operations.R, which is itself untracked, so the deletion would be irreversible. Blocker notes on Epic 9 and Epic 0A. A work-in-progress commit costs nothing and fixes all of it.
